description_en: Queries the list of collaboration models that belong to a business chain
description_zh: 查询业务链所属的协同模型列表
kebab_example: aliyun ltl list-mpcos-phase-group --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --num 1 --size 2 --biz-chain-id 4899730875490000 --name '某业务链' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListMPCoSPhaseGroup

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Minimum value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值是1
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The name of the collaboration model to query.

> If this parameter is not specified, all collaboration models are queried
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的协同模型名称。

> 若不传则查询所有协同模型
parameters.name: name
